title: SMS Forwarding Setup
description: SMS forwarding allows WoltFlow to automatically handle Cibus two-factor authentication by receiving and processing SMS verification codes on your behalf during automation runs.

whyNeeded.title: Why SMS Forwarding is Needed
whyNeeded.description: When WoltFlow logs into your Cibus account, Cibus may send a verification code to your phone for security. SMS forwarding allows our automation to receive and process these codes automatically, ensuring uninterrupted daily runs.

developerInfo.title: Developer Information
developerInfo.description: SMS forwarding requires technical setup using our API endpoint. Your SMS forwarding app will send HTTP requests to this endpoint when it receives relevant messages.

androidNotice.title: Android Compatibility Notice
androidNotice.description: Some Android SMS forwarding apps don't support custom headers. For these apps, you can pass the API key as a query parameter (apiKey=your-key). However, using headers (X-API-Key) is more secure and is the recommended approach.

queryParams.title: Query Parameters (Android Compatibility)
queryParams.description: Alternative authentication method for apps that don't support custom headers

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Replace {code} with your personal API key generated from WoltFlow settings.

androidSetup.title: Android Configuration
androidSetup.description: Choose between our official WoltFlow SMS Forwarder (recommended) or alternative apps for Android SMS forwarding.

official.title: WoltFlow SMS Forwarder
official.description: Our official SMS forwarding app designed specifically for WoltFlow integration. Features automatic configuration and optimized performance.

smsForwarder.title: SMS Forwarder
smsForwarder.description: Popular third-party app with webhook support

automate.title: Automate (Tasker)
automate.description: Advanced automation with SMS forwarding capabilities

iosSetup.title: iOS Configuration
iosSetup.description: iOS has strict restrictions on SMS access, but you can use the Shortcuts app to create automated workflows for SMS forwarding.

shortcuts.title: iOS Shortcuts Setup
shortcuts.description: Use the iOS Shortcuts app to automatically forward SMS messages from Wolt Two Factor Authentication to WoltFlow.

steps.title: Open Shortcuts App
steps.description: Launch the Shortcuts app on your iPhone and tap the "Automation" tab

steps.title: Create New Automation
steps.description: Tap the "+" button to create a new automation

steps.title: Search for "Message"
steps.description: Search for and select "Message" as your trigger

steps.title: Configure Sender
steps.description: Set the sender to "Wolt Two Factor Authentication" (the exact number will be provided later)

steps.title: Message Contains
steps.description: In "Message contains", press space then enter. This captures all messages from this number.

steps.title: Enable Immediate Activation
steps.description: Turn on "Run Immediately" to avoid manual confirmation

steps.title: Add Action: Text
steps.description: Tap "New Blank Automation" then search for and add "Text" action. Enter your WoltFlow API key here.

steps.title: Add Action: Get Contents of URL
steps.description: Search for and add "Get Contents of URL" action

steps.title: Configure HTTP Request
steps.description: Configure the HTTP request with the following details:

details.headers: Headers: Add "X-API-Key" with value from the Text box (step 7)

limitations.title: iOS Limitations
limitations.description: iOS Shortcuts requires user confirmation for network requests. While this setup works, it may require manual approval for each SMS forward. For fully automatic forwarding, consider using a dedicated Android device.

dualDevice.title: Dual Device Setup
dualDevice.description: Use an Android device or tablet for SMS forwarding while keeping your main iPhone

email2fa.title: Email 2FA Switch
email2fa.description: Check if Cibus supports email-based 2FA instead of SMS

verify.title: Verify SMS Forwarding
verify.description: After setting up your SMS forwarding, send yourself a test message containing a 6-digit verification code. Check that the message is successfully forwarded to the WoltFlow API endpoint. You can monitor this in your app's forwarding logs.

complete.description: Once SMS forwarding is configured, you can proceed to set up email forwarding to complete your automation setup.
